outcome: correlation with standard coagulation parameters (PTT, fibrinogen, platelets)
cohort: The study included 680 patients with ongoing postpartum hemorrhage (quantified blood loss >1,000 mL) from January 1, 2016, to December 31, 2019.
finding: Thromboelastography (TEG) variables correlated significantly with standard coagulation parameters, including for patients with hypofibrinogenemia, in ongoing postpartum hemorrhage.
